entry.title: Stop Losing Research Papers in Your Browser Tabs

entry.content:
Stop Losing Research Papers in Your Browser Tabs

You know the feeling. You find a great paper, read half of it, tell yourself you’ll come back, and then it’s buried under twenty other tabs. Three months later you remember there was something useful in there, but you can’t find it.

This is your research memory.

You save papers as you read them. You highlight what matters. You connect Paper A to Paper B when you notice they’re talking about the same thing. Six months from now, you search for “causal inference” or “protein folding” and every relevant paper you’ve ever read shows up, with your notes still attached.

It’s like a personal Wikipedia for the things you’re actually studying.

The local secret that isn’t on any postcard. It’s like having a friend who’s lived there for twenty years whispering in your ear as you walk.

You don’t need to plan anything. Just start walking, and let the city tell you what it’s made of.

entry.title: Finally Learn Mandarin Pronunciation Without Pinyin Confusion
entry.summary: Stop sounding like a foreigner. Learn Mandarin using Zhuyin — the phonetic system Taiwan uses — so you actually pronounce tones and sounds correctly from day one.
entry.content:
Finally Learn Mandarin Pronunciation Without Pinyin Confusion

Pinyin lies to you.

It uses familiar English letters, so your brain reads them like English. “q” isn’t “q.” “x” isn’t “x.” You think you’re saying it right, and native speakers hear something completely different.

Taiwan doesn’t use Pinyin to teach kids. They use Zhuyin — Bopomofo — a completely separate set of symbols that don’t pretend to be English. No bad habits. No false cognates. Just the sounds, exactly as they are.

This is a trainer built around that system. You learn the symbols, you hear the sounds, you practice until your mouth knows what to do. There’s a reader mode so you can see Zhuyin layered over real text and actually read it out loud.

Stop mispronouncing Mandarin. Start with the system that doesn’t trick you.

Start learning

entry.summary: Every city has a secret language—a hidden history etched into its architecture and a vibrant energy pulse in its local events. Often, as travelers, we only scratch the surface. This realization was the spark for my latest experiment: a personal, AI-powered companion designed to unveil the hidden stories …
entry.content:
Every city has a secret language—a hidden history etched into its architecture and a vibrant energy pulse in its local events. Often, as travelers, we only scratch the surface. This realization was the spark for my latest experiment: a personal, AI-powered companion designed to unveil the hidden stories of the world in real-time.

I’m excited to share the journey of creating an AI-assisted tour guide app that transforms a simple walk into an immersive exploration.

The Vision: More than a Map

The goal wasn’t just to list landmarks, but to synthesize a rich, interactive, and personalized touring experience using the power of Large Language Models (LLMs).

What it does:

  • Intelligent Landmark Discovery: The app doesn’t just look for markers; it understands the context of your surroundings to suggest meaningful points of interest.
  • Narrative Weaving: By researching local events and deep history, it provides more than just facts—it tells the story of the place.
  • Multi-Sensory Interaction: Every discovery includes a guided introduction, a visual context, and seamless audio narration to keep your eyes on the world, not your screen.

Experience the experiment for yourself here:

Explore the AI Tour Guide

New Link

This is just the beginning of how we can use AI to deepen our connection with the physical world. I’m eager to hear how it changes your perspective on your next journey.
